column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for each conservation and maintenance record. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the environmental reading linked to maintenance. FK to EnvironmentalReadingsCore.monitor_code.
BIGINT. Reference to the surface and physical readings linked to maintenance. FK to SurfaceAndPhysicalReadings.surf_id.
TEXT. Treatment status of the artifact or worksite. Possible values: In Progress, Not Required, Scheduled.
TEXT. Priority tag for the conservation or maintenance action. Possible values: High, Low, Medium, Urgent.
DATE. Date when the artifact or worksite was last cleaned. Example: 16-Dec-24.
DATE. Date when the next cleaning is due. Example: 2025/5/10.
BIGINT. Number of days since the last cleaning. Example: 83.0.
TEXT. Maintenance log details. Possible values: Pending, Review, Updated.
TEXT. Status of any incidents related to the artifact or worksite. Possible values: Closed, Open.
TEXT. Status of any drills conducted for emergency preparedness. Possible values: Current, Due, Overdue.
TEXT. Training status for maintenance personnel. Possible values: Current, Due, Overdue.
TEXT. Budget allocated for conservation and maintenance. Possible values: Adequate, Insufficient, Review Required.
TEXT. Status of the maintenance budget. Possible values: Available, Depleted, Limited.
TEXT. Frequency of conservation activities. Possible values: Frequent, Occasional, Rare.
TEXT. Historical data related to conservation and maintenance. Possible values: Extensive, Minimal, Moderate.
BIGINT. Reference to previous treatment or maintenance action. Example: 4.
TEXT. Effectiveness of the treatment applied. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
TEXT. Potential for reversing damage or deterioration. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.
